How I work

A simple process, no surprises.

From our first chat to launch day, you'll always know what's happening, what it costs and when it will be ready.

01

Discover

A free chat to understand your business, your customers and what's not working. Then you get a clear plan and a fixed quote.

02

Plan & Design

I map out the pages and design how your site will look. You review it and ask for changes before any building starts.

03

Build & Test

I build your site, then test it on phones, tablets and computers. I also check speed, forms, payments and SEO basics.

04

Launch & Support

We go live together. I show you how to manage your site and stay on hand for fixes, updates and questions.

Services

Website problems I solve.

Most business owners come to me with one of these problems. If any of them sounds familiar, you don't have to fix it alone.

My website is too slow.

Slow pages drive visitors away before they ever see what you offer, and Google ranks slow sites lower.

The fixSpeed optimization: image compression, cleaner code, caching and better hosting.
People visit, but nobody buys.

Traffic without sales usually means the site is confusing, hard to trust or difficult to check out on.

The fixClearer layout, stronger calls to action, trust signals and a smoother checkout.
I can't be found on Google.

If customers can't find you when they search, they'll find your competitors instead.

The fixSEO setup: page titles, Google Search Console, sitemaps and Google Business Profile.
My site looks broken on phones.

Most of your visitors are on mobile. If text is tiny or buttons don't work, they leave.

The fixA fully responsive, mobile-first design that works on every screen size.
My website looks outdated.

An old-looking site makes a good business look unprofessional and costs you customers' trust.

The fixA modern redesign that reflects your brand and makes you look credible.
Payments aren't working.

A broken checkout or failed payment means lost money and frustrated customers.

The fixPayment setup and fixes for Paystack, Flutterwave, Stripe, PayPal and Shopify Payments.
My site got hacked or keeps breaking.

Errors, malware and broken plugins can take your business offline without warning.

The fixSecurity clean-up, SSL, regular backups, updates and ongoing maintenance.
I don't have a website yet.

Without a website, you're missing customers who look you up online before they buy.

The fixA professional website or online store built from scratch on the right platform.
Not sure what's wrong with your website?

Send me the link and I'll tell you what's holding it back. It's free.
